summary: Local Content Share is a self-hosted utility designed for internal networks to store and distribute text snippets and files. It provides a centralised workspace for sharing data locally without relying on external cloud services. The project is implemented in Go and distributed as a container image under the MIT licence.
goodFor: Home lab operators or small offices needing a lightweight internal drop-box for quick file transfers and text sharing.
watchOut: The development velocity is currently low, indicating potential risks for long-term maintenance and unpatched security issues.
deployNotes: As a containerised Go application, it typically requires persistent volume mounts to retain uploaded files and configuration data across restarts, alongside a standard reverse proxy for TLS termination.
